'''Box Canyon''' was a small canyon located on the southeastern edge of the [[Sundari Flatlands]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established the [[Upper Sundari Outpost]] in the canyon, which was relatively hidden from the rest of the war-torn area.
